about: Plenum harness routes (D34 cards, D35 plenum). Points are [frame angle, x, y, z]: x radial and y tangential (CCW) in a frame rotated by the angle; bay frames are 45/135/225/315, site frames 0/90/180/270. Ports come from OpenSCAD (part=harness_ports). scripts/harness.py fillets every corner at the cable's minimum bend radius and checks it; OpenSCAD checks the swept tubes against all solids. Model lengths, not a measured loom.
